title: Stop keeps a site call that was not yet sent from being sent; a write already on the wire is not sent twice
steps: S1: Through the shipped bundle, abort the turn's signal while a write waits for another conversation's lease.
S2: Abort the turn's signal while a write is on the wire and its answer is lost.
S3: Abort the turn's signal during a WordPress replace across several records.
S4: Call tracy_emdash with the turn's signal already aborted.
expect: S1: the call answers TURN_STOPPED at once and nothing more is sent.
S2: the write runs to its answer and no second send follows; a lost answer stays unknown.
S3: the write on the wire lands; no later write or undo is sent.
S4: nothing runs in the site container.

selectors.code: turn-stop.mjs, index.ts turnSignal, site-call.mjs runSiteCall signal, replace-emdash.mjs emdashScriptRoad signal

evidence: Review 19/10/2026: no site tool read the turn's abort signal; a write waiting for the lease landed up to 100 s after Stop while the session log said the call was aborted
fence: Every send asks the turn's signal first; a send on the wire is never cut

tests: 🔒 C2: Stop while the write waits for the lease — nothing more is sent, at once
🔒 C2: Stop while a write is on the wire — it runs to its answer, and no second send follows (a lost answer stays unknown)
🔒 C2: Stop during a replace across several records — the write on the wire lands, no later write or undo is sent
🔒 C2: a tracy_emdash call after Stop runs nothing in the site container
